name: prophet-platform
purpose: Platform/infrastructure management hub for SocioProphet — runtime services, GitOps wiring, and platform-level documentation.
non_goals: Defining standards or governance norms (those live in dedicated standards repos).
Hosting canonical ontologies or semantic schemas (use socioprophet-standards-storage / TypeDB repos).
Acting as a documentation-only repository (socioprophet-docs handles narrative publishing).
intended_users: Platform engineers operating the SocioProphet runtime
Contributors integrating upstream contracts into the platform
Operators managing Kubernetes deployments via Argo CD
